discovery: Pioneering artificial electromagnetic materials: photonic band-gap crystals and metamaterials enabling control of light
rationale: Recent prizes covered AMO (attosecond, 2023), machine learning/statistical physics (2024) and superconducting quantum circuits (2025), so the committee may turn to optics and photonics. Photonic crystals (Yablonovitch, John, 1987) and metamaterials/negative refraction/cloaking (Pendry) are long-cited, mature fields with broad technological impact and are perennial Clarivate-style favourites.
